Sandbox_PZCB_Schedule_tooltip:
When Life and Living TV reruns its programmes after the original broadcast ends.
Back to back: the full schedule restarts the day after it ends (plus Days Off Air).
Monthly: the full schedule airs from the 1st of every month (ending the 10th at noon), then the channel is off air until the next 1st.
Sandbox_PZCB_DaysOffAir: Days Off Air Between Reruns (Back to back only)
Sandbox_PZCB_DaysOffAir_tooltip:
Only used when Rerun Schedule is Back to back. Number of full days the channel stays off air before the next rerun starts. 0 = the next rerun starts the day after the last one ends.
Ignored for Monthly, which always starts on the 1st of each month whatever its length.
Sandbox_PZCB_RerunXP_tooltip:
On: every airing of a Life and Living show gives skill XP, still limited by Media XP Level Cutoff.
Off: each character gets skill XP from each part of a show only the first time they watch it. Reruns still reduce boredom and teach any recipes the character missed.
